text: If your plans are outdoors today, get after it early, because tonight's the trade-off for this stretch of nice weather. Sunday's a good one, partly sunny with a high near 79, light south wind, and air quality that's clean across the board. The lake stays friendly through the afternoon too, waves a foot or less, though winds build into the 15 to 20 knot range later, so plan boating for morning through midday rather than evening. That's when the pattern turns: showers likely after 8pm tonight, and the European model is notably wetter than the American guidance, so I'd bet on a solid soaking rather than a token sprinkle, a quarter to half inch is a good bet. Monday carries the shower and thunderstorm chances into the afternoon, high near 77, breezy and unsettled, with the lake kicking up to 2 to 4 feet before calming toward evening. Good beach and paddle window today until winds pick up, say early afternoon; keep the umbrella by the door tonight and have a backup plan for Monday outdoor plans.
